trophies.label: Trophies
trophies.description: Days Gone platinum trophy checklist progress.
trophies.requirement: Track all 46 base-game trophies, including the platinum.

routecollectibles.label: Route Collectibles
routecollectibles.description: Manual route pickups from your local spreadsheet and notes.
routecollectibles.requirement: This route currently plans 201 manual pickups from your local notes. For 100% tracking, the run also needs all collectible categories finished, not just the platinum threshold.

encampmentjobs.label: Camp Jobs
encampmentjobs.description: Friendly encampment side missions that help push trust and credits.
encampmentjobs.requirement: Local route target from the workbook: 34 camp jobs.

nerosites.label: NERO Sites
nerosites.description: Combined NERO checkpoints and research sites for injector, recorder, IPCA, and route-flow tracking.
nerosites.requirement: Track all 30 NERO injector sites: 12 checkpoints plus 18 research sites.

infestations.label: Infestation Zones
infestations.description: Nest cleanups that unlock safer travel and route flow.
infestations.requirement: Local route target from the workbook: 12 infestation clears.

ambushcamps.label: Ambush Camps
ambushcamps.description: Enemy camp clears that reveal map information and recipes.
ambushcamps.requirement: Local route target from the workbook: 15 camp clears in this bucket.

hordes.label: Horde Clears
hordes.description: The main late-game trust, XP, and Freaker ear cleanup path.
hordes.requirement: Track all 37 planned horde clears. These are also the fastest path toward 45 skills and late trust.

nerointel.label: NERO Intel
nerointel.description: All NERO Intel pickups for 100% collectible completion.
nerointel.requirement: Track all 52 NERO Intel collectibles for full completion, not just the route subset from the workbook.

sarahlabnotes.label: Sarah's Lab Notes
sarahlabnotes.description: Late-story lab notes tied to the full collectible set.
sarahlabnotes.requirement: Track all 6 Sarah's Lab Notes for 100% collectibles.

radiofreeoregon.label: Radio Free Oregon
radiofreeoregon.description: Story radio broadcasts that count toward full collectible completion.
radiofreeoregon.requirement: Track all 20 Radio Free Oregon broadcasts for 100% collectibles.

colonelspeeches.label: Colonel Garret's Speeches
colonelspeeches.description: Wizard Island speech collectibles in the late game.
colonelspeeches.requirement: Track all 6 Colonel Garret's Speeches for 100% collectibles.

historical.label: Historic Markers
historical.description: Historical markers and landmark stops folded into the route.
historical.requirement: Track all 43 historic marker pickups in the route.

charactercollectibles.label: Character Collectibles
charactercollectibles.description: Camp journals, notes, and character-specific pickups.

tourism.label: Tourism Collectibles
tourism.description: Postcards, menus, signs, and other tourism collectibles.
tourism.requirement: Track all 28 tourism pickups in the route.

rippersermons.label: Ripper Sermons
rippersermons.description: R.I.P. sermon pickups concentrated around Lost Lake and Iron Butte.
rippersermons.requirement: Track all 13 sermon pickups in the route.

herbology.label: Herbology
herbology.description: Plant pickups used for kitchen turn-ins and collectible cleanup.
herbology.requirement: Track all 33 herbology pickups in the route.

ipca.label: IPCA Tech
ipca.description: IPCA component route for the post-story secret weapon cleanup.
ipca.requirement: Track all 18 IPCA pickups. Bend Studio's end-game guide also calls out all 18 components as a post-story target.

songs.label: Camp Guitar Songs
songs.description: The Lost Lake guitar performance collectibles.

cairns.label: Anarchist Cairns
cairns.description: Stone cairn cleanup for the cairn trophy path.

deaths.label: Deaths
deaths.requirement: Turn on in Settings when this run should show deaths.
